Title: [E7.S3.T1] Create Net Worth Query
Description:
Create Convex query for net worth calculation.

**Files Created/Modified:** convex/reports.ts

**Query:** getNetWorthTrend(userId, startDate, endDate)

**Calculates:**
- Total income (cumulative)
- Total savings (goals)
- Total debts
- Net worth = income + savings - debts

**Returns:**
- Array of {month, netWorth, income, savings, debts}

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Query created
- [ ] Calculation accurate
- [ ] Returns breakdown
- [ ] Aggregates by month
